verdict.rationale: Glama's documented integration paths are pre-filled MCP config blocks for desktop and IDE clients (Cursor, Claude Desktop, Claude Code, VS Code) and a Gateway URL. Nothing in the evidence documents adapters for Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, CrewAI, or the OpenAI or Anthropic SDKs. The OpenAPI spec 'for generating a client' covers only the directory API and is a developer building block, not a framework adapter, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can plug the platform's tools into major agent frameworks and SDKs (Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI or Anthropic SDKs) with documented adapters
